Package de.abas.eks.jfop.remote

Enthält die Klassen, mit denen die Funktionalität der FO erreichbar ist.

See: Description

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    ContextRunnable
    Server-side programs (JFOPs), which use the Java object interface should implement this interface in order to be able to receive a context for the creation/query of database objects.
    FOPRunnable
    Interface which must implement all remote JFOPs
    FOPSessionContext
    The FO session context.
    StatefulFOPRunnable
    If a JFOP implements this interface, the same instance is always used for each call in the same context (the same GUI screen, for example).
    StatefulRunnable
    If a JFOP implements this interface the same instance is always used for each call in the same context (the same GUI screen, for example).
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    C
    Communication limits for JFOP client and abas ERP.
    EKS
    This class enables complete access to the FO.
    EKSe
    This class enables complete access to the FO.
    FO
    This class makes FO access available whereby the individual methods have respective command-specific parameter lists.
    FOe
    This class provides FO accesses, whereby the individual methods have command-specific parameter lists respectively.
  • Exception Summary 
    Exception Description
    CommunicationException
    Occurs when there is an error in the connection between abas ERP and the JFOP server.
    ConnectionLostException
    Special CommunicationException which is triggered if the connection between a FOPRunnerThread and the ERP process was closed.
